info.name: Core Banking Application (CBA) API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the CBA platform.

Setup:
1. Set base_url variable (default: http://localhost:8080)
2. Set access_token variable with a Keycloak JWT Bearer token
3. Set tenant_id variable (default: default)

Obtaining a token:
  POST http://localhost:8180/realms/cba/protocol/openid-connect/token
  client_id=cba-web&grant_type=password&username=admin@cba.com&password=Admin@123

Demo credentials: admin@cba.com/Admin@123, teller@cba.com/Teller@123, customer@cba.com/Customer@123

Code samples available in: cURL, JavaScript (fetch), Python (requests), Java (OkHttp), C# (HttpClient), PHP (cURL), Go (net/http), Ruby (Net::HTTP)

x-code-samples.source:
curl -X GET '{{base_url}}/api/v1/customers' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}'  \
  -H 'X-Tenant-ID: {{tenant_id}}'

<?php
curl_setopt_array($ch = curl_init(), [
    CURLOPT_URL => '{{base_url}}/api/v1/customers',
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'GET',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}', 'X-Tenant-ID: {{tenant_id}}'],
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true
]);
echo curl_exec($ch); curl_close($ch);

import "net/http"

func call() {
    req, _ := http.NewRequest("GET", "{{base_url}}/api/v1/customers", nil)
    req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer {{access_token}}")  
    req.Header.Set("X-Tenant-ID", "{{tenant_id}}")  
    resp, _ := new(http.Client).Do(req)
    defer resp.Body.Close()
}

puts Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port).request(req).body
